title: Two-lane search beats the unseeded baseline on a fresh pool seed
hypothesis: Seeding six slots from the fittable bank with rollout-selected fitting raises held-out success over nine unseeded zero-shot candidates, because the bank structures are the only ones fitting has ever helped.

prediction.against: logs/baseline_gpt61_sol_high best candidate on the same fresh manifest
prediction.rationale: 0.15 on 50 paired cases is the smallest difference whose paired t interval plausibly excludes zero

protocol.command: python scripts/evaluate_on_fresh_manifest.py --pool-seed 2600 --out-dir logs/fresh_2600 --policy twolane=<best two-lane source>:<state> --policy baseline=<best baseline source>:<state> --expert --reference baseline

falsified_by: paired difference <= 0 or an interval that includes zero on the 2600 manifest
